description: This Java source file defines a validator class for the FieldType entity within the OpenMRS project. It provides validation logic for checking the correctness of FieldType objects, such as ensuring the name is not empty, does not duplicate existing non-retired types, and their lengths are appropriate.

classes.name: FieldTypeValidator
classes.description: A validator class implementing Spring's Validator interface to validate FieldType objects in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class supports validation for a given object type; returns true if the class is FieldType.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a FieldType object, ensuring it is not null, has a non-empty name, the name is not duplicated among non-retired types, and its length complies with constraints.
